note: Declared answers to gates that other parts of this repository have already addressed. This file transfers no claim and advances no experiment; see CROSS-PROGRAMME-RECONCILIATION.md. Each entry is checked by scripts/check_gate_coverage.py, which fails when either side drifts.

strengths.covers: The cited artifact answers the gate as written, on the population the gate asks for.
strengths.partial: The cited artifact answers a necessary part of the gate.
strengths.adjacent: The cited artifact answers the same question about a DIFFERENT artifact. Inadmissible for the gate; recorded so it is not rediscovered as though new.

entries.gatePhrase: defect ground truth for real repositories
entries.evidence: NIST SARD test suite 101 with real detector families and frozen source digests
entries.doesNotDischarge: KL-001's registered endpoint was not run against it; HGD-2 was not designed to.

entries.gatePhrase: derived products sharing one instrument are collapsed into one dependency family
entries.evidence: EPA collocated PM2.5, real instruments, common-mode failure injected into the collocated family only
entries.doesNotDischarge: No KL-008 registration exists. Both H-series primary claims are recorded false.

entries.gatePhrase: splits one source into many roots
entries.evidence: Whether one controlling party can manufacture apparent independence by multiplying names, keys, services or organizational labels; primary_claim true
entries.doesNotDischarge: KL-002 scopes its remainder to an agent PIPELINE assigning rootIds, which HVI-1 does not test.

entries.gatePhrase: shared upstream dependency is not representable in schema v0.1
entries.evidence: components[] carrying componentId, kind, sharedWeightLower and sharedWeightUpper -- shared dependency as interval-valued shared weight
entries.doesNotDischarge: ADV-005 is stated against the KL schema; no migration has been done.

entries.evidence: Catalogued news-descent corpora with acquisition paths and caveats; PHEME splits materialised with observable provenance
entries.doesNotDischarge: No KL-005 registration exists and no corpus is frozen for it.

entries.evidence: Root structure on real mathematical literature; 57-87% of citing literature descends from other citing literature against a 0% negative control
entries.doesNotDischarge: Literature descent is not replication outcome. KL-016 records that its own control arm collapsed.

pendingNote: These cite artifacts that exist only on unmerged branches. The checker asserts they are still absent, so that merging the branch FAILS the check and forces promotion into entries[] rather than letting the citation sit unverified. A coverage map that can cite something it cannot see is the defect this whole file exists to prevent.
